name: content-studio
description: Content Studio desktop app powered by the official Claude Agent SDK and project skills.

scripts.dist:mac: npm run build && electron-builder --config electron-builder.yml --mac dmg zip --publish never
scripts.dist:win: npm run build && electron-builder --config electron-builder.yml --win nsis --publish never
